question.text: A $20 \mathrm{~cm}$ long string, having a mass of $1.0 \mathrm{~g}$, is fixed at both the ends. The tension in the string is $0.5 \mathrm{~N}$. The string is set into vibration using an external vibrator of frequency 100 $\mathrm{Hz}$. Find the separation (in $\mathrm{cm}$ ) between the successive nodes on the string.
